sources.title: Sultan-ul-Uloom Education Society website
sources.supports: Society name as displayed: 'SULTAN-UL-ULOOM EDUCATION SOCIETY'. The page returned no address, institution list or map when fetched.

sources.title: Muffakham Jah College of Engineering and Technology website
sources.supports: College name; address 'Mount Pleasant, 8-2-249 to 267, Road No. 3, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad - 500 034'; 'spread over a sprawling 25 acre of land'; S.M. Nizamuddin Central Library; Seminar Hall (capacity 150); Ghulam Ahmed Hall; 'all the blocks in the college have ramps and lifts'.

sources.title: MJCET: other institutions of the society
sources.supports: The eight other society institutions and their websites, including 'Sultan-ul-Uloom Public School-Banjara Hills' and 'Sultan ul Uloom Public Schools - Old City'.

sources.title: MJCET: Old City schools
sources.supports: Four schools elsewhere in Hyderabad: Syed Ali Chabutra, Golconda, Khazipura, Hafiz Baba Nagar. No street addresses given.

sources.title: MJCET: sports facilities
sources.supports: Grounds for football, basketball, volleyball and cricket; gymnasium; indoor table tennis, chess, badminton and carroms. No locations given.

sources.title: MJCET NAAC SSR 2023, metric 4.1.1 index
sources.supports: The college has five blocks; auditorium named Ghulam Ahmed Hall; address.

sources.title: MJCET NAAC SSR 2023, 4.1.1-F: geotagged photographs of Blocks 1 to 5
sources.supports: Photo captions and geotag overlays dated 28 Dec 2022: Block 1, Block 2 and Block 5 at 17.4285 N 78.4439 E; Block 3 and Block 4 at 17.4277 N 78.442 E. These are camera positions printed to 3 or 4 decimals, not building centres.

sources.title: MJCET NAAC SSR 2023, 4.1.1-C: Ghulam Ahmed Hall
sources.supports: Photographs inside the hall geotagged 17.4282 N 78.4435 E (24 Nov 2018 and 5 Nov 2022) and 17.427 N 78.4416 E (2 Jan 2023). The two positions are about 240 m apart.

sources.title: MJCET NAAC SSR 2023, 4.1.1-D: sports and gymnasium
sources.supports: Basketball, volleyball, football, carroms, chess and table tennis geotagged 17.429 N 78.4451 E (Jan 2022); shuttle court beside a 'Physical Education' sign at 17.4283 N 78.4429 E; gymnasium at 17.427 N 78.4416 E.

sources.title: MJCET NAAC SSR 2023, 4.1.1-E: seminar hall
sources.supports: Main seminar hall of 150 capacity, geotagged 17.4277 N 78.442 E; a banner in the photograph reads 'Venue: Seminar Hall, Block-4, MJCET'.

sources.title: Sultan-ul-Uloom College of Pharmacy
sources.supports: Official name. No address on the page fetched.

sources.title: Sultan-Ul-Uloom College of Law
sources.supports: Official name; established 1989; 'located in a campus spread over few acres of greenery'. No address or building.

sources.title: Amjad Ali Khan College of Business Administration
sources.supports: Official name (formerly Sultan-ul-Uloom College of Business Administration); established 1991-1992. No address or building.

sources.title: Ghulam Ahmed College of Education
sources.supports: Official name; established 1985. No address or building.

sources.title: Sultan-Ul-Uloom Junior College
sources.supports: Official name; established 1994; 'situated ... in the picturesque area of Banjara Hills'. No address or building.

sources.title: CBSE affiliation record, Sultan-ul-Uloom Public School
sources.supports: School address: Mount Pleasant, 8-2-249, Road No. 3, Banjara Hills, 500034 (as reported by a web search result; the record itself was not opened).

sources.title: Wikipedia: Sultan-ul-Uloom Education Society
sources.supports: 'The 22-acre SUES campus is located in Banjara Hills'; founded 1980; institution list (incomplete compared with the official list).

sources.title: OpenStreetMap (Overpass API extract)
sources.supports: College outline (way 737548446), College of Pharmacy outline (way 737603230), six unnamed building footprints inside the outline, a garden with operator=MJCET (way 737554364), service roads and paths, gate nodes, a State Bank of India node (6212803088), Road No. 3. No building on the campus has a name or use in OSM. Data base timestamp 2026-10-09T06:11:06Z.
